about: UO Bench, version 1: decision models playing Ultima Online, by shard rules, profession and task. A player's score on a track is its share of points (a win 1, a draw 1/2) over the track's matches, with a 95% interval from a bootstrap over runs (the rounds of one run share its arena and seating, so they are not independent). A score counts as settled once that interval is within 3 points either way. A skill track scores training sessions instead, each one an independent draw: the mean of a score over sessions, with a 95% interval (the wider of Student's t and a bootstrap). Bench runs are kept apart from the training loop's selection, so that no score comes from rounds a selection has seen.

ml/duel-mage.about: Mage against the scripted mage at matched speed (it reacts in 40 ms), on five arenas, from both seats.

ml/duel-dexer.about: Dexer (sword and shield) against the scripted dexer at matched speed, on five arenas, from both seats.

ml/duel-archer.about: Archer against the scripted archer at matched speed, on five arenas, from both seats.

ml/equal-mage.about: Mage against the scripted mage, both deciding at one pace: every move acts 4 s after the state it answers, so that models of very different speeds (Jev's 3 s, Laya's 40 ms) are compared on judgement alone.

ml/equal-dexer.about: Dexer against the scripted dexer, both deciding at one pace: every move acts 4 s after the state it answers, so that models of very different speeds (Jev's 3 s, Laya's 40 ms) are compared on judgement alone.

ml/equal-archer.about: Archer against the scripted archer, both deciding at one pace: every move acts 4 s after the state it answers, so that models of very different speeds (Jev's 3 s, Laya's 40 ms) are compared on judgement alone.

ml/skill-magery.about: A mage in training (templates/mage-trainee.json: Magery, Meditation and Eval Int 50, Int 100) alone in its arena, choosing every step: a practice spell of some circle (told its mana and its chance to succeed), meditation (told its chance of a trance), or Eval Int. It trains at least 20 minutes and until Magery 70, 90 minutes at most.

scores.name: ml/skill-magery: Magery gained in 20 min
scores.about: Magery points gained in the first 20 minutes, the mean over sessions; settled within ±0.5 points over at least 20 sessions.

scores.name: ml/skill-magery: minutes from 50 to 70
scores.about: Minutes from Magery 50 to 70, counted as 90 when not reached by then (a restricted mean, so that a player that never gets there still counts); settled within ±3 minutes over at least 20 sessions.
